definitions.explanation: A place far from urban centers with limited access to services and infrastructure. Often used in policy and medical contexts to describe areas with insufficient facilities.

examples.japanese: {僻地|へきち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are few hospitals in remote areas.

examples.japanese: {僻地|へきち}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Improvements in remote-area healthcare are being called for.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{僻地|へきち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Because this village is in a remote area, it takes an hour by car just to go shopping.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in administrative and policy contexts, especially regarding healthcare ({僻地|へきち}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧) and education. Carries a somewhat negative connotation of being disadvantaged by location.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {僻地|へきち}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧ (remote-area healthcare)
- {僻地|へきち}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education in remote areas)
- {僻地|へきち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be assigned to a remote area)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秘境|ひきょう}→秘境：16500_hikyou⟧: unexplored region — romantic, adventurous connotation, unlike the practical tone of {僻地|へきち}
- ⟦{辺境|へんきょう}→辺境：14355_henkyou⟧: frontier — the edge of civilization, often used historically or geographically
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧: countryside — neutral or positive, simply means rural area
